description.purpose: The graph of one knowledge space: the nodes of every source of the space and the edges between them, resolved once, so that a cross question over many files never wakes a file. THE HIVE IS THE ADDRESS -- everything from outside is sent to the hive path and the hive hands it on.
description.use_when: One per knowledge space whose sources (a file space) announce their head moves on `source_changed` and answer `outline`, `links` and `near`.
description.not_in_scope: No model, no embedding request, no network; no content of a source (a node carries its anchor, kind, name and one line); no rights; no event to a consumer when an edge breaks -- a broken edge stands in the store with `since` and every answer counts it.
description.contract_in: Lanes on `hop.route`: source_changed (a node source announced a version, or its removal with `tomb`), in_pulled (a source's answer to one of this hive's own `pull` requests, `op_id` `gs:<part>:<source>:<version>`), in_graph (a cross question, hop `op`, `op_id`, `caller?`).
description.contract_out: Routes on `hop.route`, leaving through the hive path: pull (a read request to the announcing source: `outline`, `links` or `near`, `op_id` `gs:<part>:<source>:<version>`, no `caller`), answer (exactly one per `in_graph` question).

accepts.because: a node source moved a head: body `{source, version, path, fmt, parser, mark, nodes, links, tomb}` (`source` `fh-<12 hex>` or `ob-<12 hex>`, `nodes`/`links` the counts the source holds for that version). Answered by nothing; the hive pulls the version (three `pull` requests) or, with `tomb`, drops the source and breaks every edge into it

the answer of a node source to one of this hive's `pull` requests, the source's own `answer` restamped: hop `op_id` `gs:<part>:<source>:<version>` mirrored, body `{ok, nodes[] | links[] | near[], ...}`. Never answered

a cross question: body `{op, args}`, hop `op`, `op_id`, `caller?`. Ops `resolve {name}`, `callers {addr}`, `dependents {addr, depth <= 3}`, `deps {addr}`, `path {from, to, max <= 6}`, `similar {addr}`, `broken {}`, `stats {}`; every list takes `limit` (<= 50) and `cursor`. Answered by exactly one `answer`; no source is asked

emits.because: a read request to the source that announced a version, for the source's `in_read`: hop `op` (`outline`, `links`, `near`), `op_id` `gs:<part>:<source>:<version>`, no `caller`; body `{op, file: '<source>@<version>', args: {version, limit | k}}`. Three per announcement, whatever the size of the source

exactly one per `in_graph` question, hop `op`, `op_id` and `caller` unchanged: `{ok, op, op_id, items, next?, broken, ...}` or `{ok: false, op, op_id, error: {code, message}}`; `broken` counts the broken edges the question touched
